place.name: Tadeusz Kościuszko Monument, Kraków
place.description: The Tadeusz Kościuszko Monument in Kraków (Polish: Pomnik Tadeusza Kościuszki w Krakowie) is one of the best-known bronze monuments in Poland. It is the work of artists Leonard Marconi, Warsaw-born professor of Lviv University; and his son-in-law, sculptor Antoni Popiel.
